text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the first one across finish line is....

Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad she won! She did such a great
job!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Thanks for sharing your courage with me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do my best too! Thanks,
Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The roaring cheers engulf
Matikanetannhauser as
she looks up to
the stands from the turf.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There are so many smiling faces! So, so
many!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (I... did it!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the star of today's race is

Matikanetannhauser! She's dedicating
her
long-awaited victory to the
spectators!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What a beautiful sight... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! I won. I think that's earned me
some
bragging rights.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
For now, it's time to go grab something
yummy.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: MACHITAAAN!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Congrats on the win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you! You're an energetic one,
aren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm the slowest one in my club.
I never
win, and I've got no talent.
B-but, still...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I won't let that stop me! I wanna do my
best, just
like you!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: So thank you! Bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The girl runs off with a new spring in her
step.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I guess you could say I'm her star.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's got a nice ring to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser watches the girl's
back until
she's out of sight.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mm... All right. Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
My racing career's just getting started,
so I can't
be satisfied with just this win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Got that, Trainer? Let's keep giving it
our all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Matikanetannhauser exits the
Arima
Kinen with renewed
determination.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Oops! I think I left my phone in the
waiting
room!
